sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच मया प्रसन्नेन तवार्जुनेदं रूपं परं दर्शितमात्मयोगात्। तेजोमयं विश्वमनन्तमाद्यं यन्मे त्वदन्येन न दृष्टपूर्वम्॥
en: The great One said Being pleased with you, O Arjuna, I have by my mystic powers, shown to you this my Supreme form, glorious, universal, infinite and Primeval, which has been seen by none before, except now by you.

sa: तेजोवधमिमं कुर्याद् विभेदयिषुराहवे। यथा त्वं गुणविद्वेषादपरागं चिकीर्षसि॥
en: As you desire to do owing to your hatred towards these that endued with accomplishments. Neither age, nor wealth, nor friends,

sa: दुर्योधन महाबाहो साधु सम्यगवेक्ष्यताम्। त्यज्यतां दुष्टभावोऽयं भीष्मः किल्बिषकृत् तव॥
en: Abandon this wicked Bhishma of unrighteous nature for, O ruler of men, discord once being in your own army it will be difficult to bring union again.

sa: रथानां क्क च विज्ञानं क्व च भीष्मोऽल्पचेतनः। अहमावारयिष्यामि पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्॥
en: How vast is the difference between the task of estimating the might of Rathas and Bhishma of little intellect. I will meet the armies of the Pandavas.

sa: धृष्टकेतुं महात्मानं चेदिपुङ्गवमङ्गनाः। द्रोणेन निहतं शूरं हरन्ति हतचेतसः॥
en: There, those ladies, beside themselves with sorrow, are removing the brave and great bowman, viz., Dhrishtaketu, that foremost of the Chedis, killed by Drona.

sa: विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ पतितौ पश्य माधव। हिमान्ते पुष्पितौ शालौ मरुता गलिताविव॥ ये
en: Look, O Keshava, at the two brothers of Avanti, viz., Vinda and Anuvinda, lying their on the fled, like two blossoming Shala trees in the spring uprooted by the wind.

sa: यस्मात् परस्परं अन्तो ज्ञातयः कुरुपाण्डवाः। उपेक्षितास्ते गोविन्द तस्माज्ज्ञातीन् वधिष्यसि॥
en: Since you were indifferent to the Kurus and the Pandavas whilst they killed each other, therefore, O Govinda, you will be the destroyer of your own kinsmen.

sa: द्विजेम्यो गुणमुख्येभ्यो नैगमेभयश्च सर्वशः। प्रतिगृह्याशिषो मुख्यास्तथा धर्मभृतां वरः॥
en: That foremost of righteous men set himself to acquire the substantial blessings of the Brahmanas, of the foremost inilitary officers, and the leading citizens.

sa: वासुदेवेन तीर्थेन पुत्र संशाम्य पाण्डवैः॥ संधानस्य परः कालस्तवेति च पुनः पुनः।
en: I further advised him that depending on Vasudeva as his refuge, he should make peace with the Pandavas, Indeed, I repeatedly told him, “This is the fittest time for you to make peace.'

sa: न यज्ञाः सम्प्रवर्तेयुर्विधिवत् स्वाप्तदक्षिणाः। न विवाहाः समाजो वा यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥
en: Sacrifices, duly finished with presents according to the ordinance, would no longer be celebrated and no marriage would take place; society itself would cease to exist, if the king did not observe the duty of protection.

sa: त्रस्तमुद्विग्नहृदयं हाहाभूतमचेतनम्। क्षणेन विनशेत् सर्वं यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥
en: In the absence of king's protection, all things, filled with fear and anxiety and becoming senseless and uttering cries of misery would be ruined in no time.

sa: न संवत्सरसत्राणि तिष्ठेयुरकुतोभयाः। विधिवद् दक्षिणावन्ति यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥
en: No sacrifices extending for a year and finished with presents according to the ordinance would take place if the king did not observe the duty of protection.

sa: द्रोणो वा रथिनां श्रेष्ठः कृपो मद्रेश्वरोऽपि वा। तथापि सम्भ्रमो न स्यात् त्वामाश्रित्य महाभुज॥
en: Or Drona that foremost of car-warriors or Kripa or the ruler of the Madras himself, even then fear would not enter my heart, O you of mighty arms, as long as I am under the shadow of your protection.

sa: त्वया सुबहवो युद्धे निर्जिताः शत्रुसूदन। दंशिताः क्रूरकर्माणः काम्बोजा युद्धदुर्मदाः॥
en: O slayer of hostile heroes, numerous Kambojas covered in coats of mail, of dreadful deeds and difficult of defeat in battle, have already been worsted by you;

sa: तत्राप्युपस्पृश्य बल: सरस्वत्यां महाबलः॥ सूभूमिकं ततोऽगच्छत् सरस्वत्यास्तटे वरे।
en: Having bathed in that tirtha of the Sarasvati, the powerful Baladeva then went to Subhumika situate on the excellent bank of the same river.

sa: एकतामगमन् सर्वे असुरा राक्षसैः सह। युद्धमासीन्महाघोरं वीर त्रैलोक्यमोहनम्॥
en: And the Asuras assembled together with the Raksasas; and, C hero, mighty was the battle that was fought, striking terror into the three worlds.

sa: भ्रातरं निहतं श्रुत्वा रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। महोदरमहापाचौं शोकाक्रान्तौ बभूवतुः॥
en: Mahodara' and Mahāpārśvahearing of their uncle slain by Rāma of untiring deeds, were overcome with grief. 1. Huge-bellied. 2. Mighty flanked.

sa: ततो जलधरोदग्रस्ताडितो देवदुन्दुभिः। तस्मिन्नुदाहृते शापे पुष्पवृष्टिश्च खाच्च्युता॥
en: As he uttered this imprecation, the celestial kettle-drums sounded like the roaring of clouds; and blossoms showered down from the sky.

sa: दीप्यमाने ततस्तस्य लाङ्कलाग्रे हनूमतः॥ राक्षस्यस्ता विरूपाक्ष्यः शंसुर्देव्यास्तदप्रियम्।
en: On Hanumān's tail being in flames, Rākṣasīs of frightful eyes related to that exalted lady (Sītā) tidings of this great mishap.

sa: अथान्तर्गृहमाविश्य राजा दशरथस्तदा। सूतमामन्त्रयामास रामं पुनरिहानय॥
en: Then entering the inner apartment king Dasaratha said to the charioteer Sumantra, "Do you again bring Rāma here.'

sa: प्रविश्य चात्मनो वेश्म राज्ञाऽऽदिष्टेऽभिषेचने। तत्क्षणादेव निष्क्रम्य मातुरन्तःपुरं ययौ ॥
en: And entering his residence in the interests of the installation ordered by the monarch, he immediately issued out, and went to the inner apartment of his mother.

sa: तस्मात्त्वां शरणं प्राप्ता वायुनोपहता वयम्॥ वायुसंरोधजं दुःखमिदं नो नुद दुःखहन्।
en: Being thus distressed by the wind we have come to seek your shelter. O you the remover of miseries-do you remove our affictions consequent upon the obstruction of the wind..

sa: तस्य मूर्जा प्रणम्य त्वं सपुत्रः ससुहृज्जनः। राजस्तिष्ठ स्वसमये भर्तुर्भार्येव तद्वशे॥
en: Bowing to him, with your children and friends, do you, O king, satisfying your promise, seek his shelter like to a wife placing herself under the control of her husband.

sa: न रामरामानुजशासनं त्वया कपीन्द्र युक्तं मनसाऽप्यपोहितुम्। मनो हि ते ज्ञास्यति मानुषं बलं सराघवस्यास्य सुरेन्द्रवर्चसः॥
en: O lord of monkeys, it does not behove you, to neglect even in thought, the behests of Rāma and his younger brother; for you are fully aware of the prowess of Rāghava like to the lord of celestials, and passing human power.

sa: कच्चिदक्षौहिणी भीमां भरतो भ्रातृवत्सलः। ध्वजिन मन्त्रिभिर्गुप्तां प्रेषयिष्यति मत्कृते॥
en: Will not Bharata, ever devoted to his brother, send out one Akşauhiņī of terrible soldiers under the command of his ministers for my rescue?

sa: सदृशो धर्मसम्बन्धः सदृशो रूपसम्पदा। रामलक्ष्मणयो राजन् सीता चोर्मिलया सह॥
en: O monarch, this youthful union of Rāma and Lakşmaņa with Sītā and Urmilā is fit by all means; and it is worthy of their wealth of grace.

sa: मेघाभिकामा परिसम्पतन्ती सम्मोदिता भाति बलाकपंक्तिः। वातावधूता वरपौण्डरीकी लम्बेव माला रुचिराम्बरस्य॥
en: And rows of cranes, fond of clouds, rising up in the sky, delighted and moved by the wind, are appearing like a garland of white lotuses, spread along the welkin.

sa: स्वनैर्घनानां प्लवगाः प्रबुद्धा विहाय निद्रां चिरसंनिरुद्धाम्। अनेकरूपाकृतिवर्णनादा नवाम्बुधाराभिहता नदन्ति ॥
en: And rising from their perpetual sleep by the muttering of clouds, the frogs, assuming various shapes and making diverse sounds, are setting up cries being distressed with new watery showers.

sa: अयात्रां चैव दृष्ट्वेमां मार्गाश्च भृशदुर्गमान्। प्रणते चैव सुग्रीवे न मया किंचिदीरितम्॥
en: Owing to the unfitness of the season (for marching against my foe) and the wayfares being inaccessible, I cannot possibly request Sugrīva (to march) although he is prepared to abide by my mandate.

sa: अपि चापि परिक्लिष्टं चिराद् दारैः समागतम्। आत्मकार्यगरीयस्त्वाद् वक्तुं नेच्छामि वानरम्॥
en: Moreover after a good deal of affliction he has regained his wives, and my service is of very great difficulty; so I do not wish to request that monkey-chief now.

sa: वृन्दवृन्दैरयोध्यायां राजमार्गाः समन्ततः। बभूवुरभिसम्बाधाः कुतूहलजनैर्वृताः॥
en: On all sides, Ayodhya's high ways were crowded with groups of men full of curiosity.

sa: अहं दुर्गं गमिष्यामि वनं पुरुषवर्जितम्। नानामृगगणाकीर्णं शार्दूलगणसेवितम्॥
en: I shall wend my way to the forest impassable, devoid of men, inhabited by various deers, tigers and other voracious animals.

sa: निवेश्यतां तत्र पुरमङ्गदस्य महात्मनः। चन्द्रकेतोः सुरुचिरं चन्द्रकान्तं निरामयम्॥
en: Let the city for high souled Angada be established there. And let the beautiful and healthy country of Candradkānta be the kingdom of Candraketu.

sa: अरजापि रुदन्ती सा आश्रमस्याविदूरतः। प्रतीक्षते सुसंत्रस्ता पितरं देवसंनिभम्॥
en: Arajă cried aloud in forest at no distance from the hermitage and waited for here sire who had been away on visiting the celestials.

sa: स हेमजालविततं भानुभास्वरदर्शनम्। ददर्श विपुलं रम्यं राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम्॥
en: Then he saw the grand and graceful residence of the lord of the Räkşasas, having golden networks and sun-bright to behold.

sa: क्षिप्रमेष्यति काकुत्स्थो हपृक्षप्रवरैर्वृतः। यस्ते युधि विजित्यारीशोकं व्यपनयिष्यति॥
en: Soon shall Käkutstha come, surrounded by the foremost monkeys and bears; and, vanquishing the foe in fight, shall remove your grief.

sa: तदस्मिन्कार्यनिर्योगे वीरैवं दुरतिक्रमे। किं पश्यसे समाधानं त्वं हि कार्यविदां वरः॥
en: Then, for the accomplishment of this work, difficult to compass, what, O hero, O you best of those conversant with business, what way do you see as to its success?

sa: सृजन्तो बाणवृष्टिं ते रथगर्जितनि:स्वनाः। प्रावृट्काल इवाम्भोदा विचेरुनैर्ऋताम्बुदाः॥
en: And with their cars sending roars, the Rākşasas, pouring showers of shafts, ranged (the field), resembling clouds during the rainy season.

sa: स शरान्वञ्चयामास तेषामाशुचरः कपिः। रथवेगांश्च वीराणां विचरन्विमलेऽम्बरे॥
en: That swift-speeding monkey, coursing the cloudless sky, evaded those shafts of those heroes, as well as the impetuosity of their cars.

sa: एतैर्निमित्तैरपरैश्च सुभ्रूः संचोदिता प्रागपि साधुसिद्धैः। वातातपक्लान्तमिव प्रणष्टं वर्षेण बीजं प्रतिसंजहर्ष॥
en: And being enlivened by those and various other auspicious omens, she attained joy like to a seed, spoiled by the wind and the sun, growing afresh in the rainy season.

sa: तस्यास्य वसतोऽरण्ये नियतस्य महात्मनः। रावणेन हृता भार्या स त्वां शरणमागतः॥
en: While that high-souled one having his senses under control was dwelling in the woods, his wife was carried off by Rāvana; and he (Rāma) has (in consequence) sought your protection.

sa: भवता सत्यकामो तौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। प्रगृह्य चार्चयस्वैतौ पूजनीयतमाबुभौ॥
en: Do you, granting an interview to the brothers Rāma and Lakşmaņa-both of them worthy of homage-who pe eager for your friendship, receive them respectfully.

sa: दृष्ट्वैव विललापा” बाष्पसंदिग्धया गिरा। अशक्नुवन् वारयितुं धैर्याद् वचनमब्रुवन् ॥
en: And soon as Bharata saw Rāma, he, exceedingly distressed, broke out into lamentations in words choked with sorrow. And incapable of holding himself in patience, he said.

sa: उत्तरेभ्यः कुरुभ्यश्च वनं दिव्योपभोगवत्। आजगाम नदी सौम्या तीरजैर्बहुभिर्वृता॥
en: From the north Kuru had spread a wood capable of conferring every enjoyment; and a beautiful river coursed through bordered by many a tree.

sa: दत्त्वा चैव बहून् दायान् विप्राणां विप्रवत्सलः। ससर्ज यत्र भगवाँल्लोकाँल्लोकपितामहः॥
en: He, that would renounce his body on the northern bank of the Sarasvati containing profuse water, reciting mentally sacred mantras, would never again he visited by death.'

sa: रणाद् भरतश्रेष्ठ तावकाः प्राद्रवन् दिशः। धावतश्चाप्यपश्याम श्वसमानाशराहतान्॥
en: Indeed chief of the Bharatas, your soldiers fled on all sides. Stuck with arrows, they were seen to run, breathing hard.

sa: एवमेतन्मनुष्येन्द्र शूरैः प्राज्ञैर्बहुश्रुतैः। कुलीनैः सह शक्येत कृत्स्ना जेतुं वसुन्धरा॥
en: Thus, O monarch, a king may succeed in subjugating the entire Earth if he has for his ministers men endued with courage, wisdom, great learning, and high-birth.

sa: वध्यमानं महाराज पाण्डवैर्जितकाशिभिः। दिशो भेजेऽथसम्भ्रान्तं भ्रामितं दृढधन्विभिः॥
en: Struck, O king, by those firm bowmen of the Pandavas, the Kuru army, filled with fear, fled away on all sides.

sa: वध्यमानं महाराज पाण्डवैर्जितकाशिभिः। दिशो भेजेऽथसम्भ्रान्तं भ्रामितं दृढधन्विभिः॥
en: Struck, O king, by those firm bowmen of the Pandavas, the Kuru army, filled with fear, fled away on all sides.

sa: यस्मिन्नर्थे हितं यत् स्यात् तद्वर्ण रूपमादिशेत्। बहुरूपस्य राज्ञो हि सूक्ष्मोऽप्यर्थो न सीदति॥
en: He must assume that particular colour or form which is beneficial for the particular object which he tries to achieve. A king who can put on various forms succeeds in achieving even the most subtile objects.

sa: एतदेकपदं शक्र सर्वलोकसुखावहम्। आचरन् सर्वभूतेषु प्रियो भवति सर्वदा॥
en: This is the one thing, O Shakra, which yields happiness to all. By practising it, one may always secure the love of all creatures.

sa: मुहूर्तमिव तौ गत्वा नर्दमाने युधिष्ठिरे। स्मित्वा ततो मद्रपतिरन्यं स्यन्दनमास्थितः॥
en: After the two had gone for a moment, they heard Yudhishthira cry aloud. Stopping, the ruler of the Madras he then got upon another well equipi car.

sa: एतमर्थमभिज्ञाय देवराजः शतक्रतुः,॥ तस्मिंस्तीर्थे वीरे स्नात्वा विमुक्तः पाप्मना किल।
en: Ascertaining all this, the king of the celestials, viz., Indra, of a hundred sacrifices, bathed in that best of tirthas and was freed of a grievous sin."

sa: नमुचिर्वासवाद् भीत: सूर्यरश्मि समाविशत्॥ तेनेन्द्रः सख्यमकरोत् समयं चेदमब्रवीत्। न चाद्रेण न शुष्केण न रात्रौ नापि चाहनि॥ वधिष्याप्यसुरश्रेष्ठ सखे सत्येन ते शपे।
en: The Asura Namuchi, from fear of Vasava, had entered into a ray of the Sun. Indra then made friends with Namuchi and made a contract with him, saying-"O king, of Asuras, I shall not kill you, O friend, with anything that is wet or dry. I shall not kill you in the night or in the day! Forsooth I swear this to you.'

sa: सर्वं जिह्यं मृत्युपदमार्जवं ब्रह्मणः पदम्। एतावाज्ञानविषयः किं प्रलापः करिष्यति॥
en: All sorts of crookedness mean death and all sorts of sincerity are called Brahma. This is the subject of knowledge. The verses of philosophers cannot affect this.

sa: शरीरवृत्तमास्थाय इत्येषा श्रूयते श्रुतिः। नातिसम्यक् प्रणीतानि ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: We have heard this Shruti that the sacrifice which high-souled Brahmanas perform by wealth acquired by excessive physical labour, does not yield great merit.

sa: पुनश्चास्य धनुश्चित्रं गजराजकरोपमम्। क्षुरेण शितधारेण प्रचकर्त नराधिपः॥
en: Again the king, with a sharp razor-faced arrow, cut off the beautiful bow of Bhima resembling the trunk of an elephant.

sa: तेषामेतमभिप्रायं चतुर्णामुपलक्ष्य सः॥ युगपद् योगमास्थाय ससर्ज विविधास्तनूः।
en: Understanding the desire of each of those four, he had recourse to his Yoga powers and assumed simultaneously four different forms.

sa: जागर्ति च कथं दण्डः प्रजास्ववहितात्मकः। कश्च पूर्वापरमिदं जागर्ति प्रतिपालयन्॥
en: Of what is he made? Whence is his origin? What are his features? What is his splendour? How does he remain awake among living creatures so vigilantly?

sa: ततः स भगवान् धीमान् सर्वलोकपितामहः। मनसा चिन्तयामास किमयं लभतामिति॥
en: Thereat, the worshipful grandfather of all the worlds, endued with great intelligence, began to think within his mind as to what he should confer of that youth.

sa: पुरःसरो ममाधास्तु भीमः शस्त्रभृतां वरः॥ एवमभ्यधिकः शल्याद् भविष्यामि महामृधे।
en: And let Bhima, the foremost of warriors, fight in my front. I shall thus be superior to Shalya in the great battle that will soon take place.”

sa: पितामहस्य महतो वर्तमाने महामखे। वितते यज्ञवाटे च संसिद्धेषु द्विजातिषु॥
en: Brahma had at one time celebrated a great sacrifice. While that sacrifice was being celebrated on the site selected, many Rishis, crowned with ascetic success, came there.

sa: तस्मात् ते वर्तयिष्यामि दुर्गकर्म विशेषतः। श्रुत्वा तथा विधातव्यमनुष्ठेयं च यत्नतः॥
en: I shall, therefore, describe to you this subject, referring especially to the defences of forts. Having heard me, you should make the arrangements required and conduct yourself attentively as directed.

sa: तत्र शृङ्गे हिमवतो मेरौ कनकपर्वते। यत्र मुजावटे रामो जटाहरणमादिशत्॥
en: There, on that peak of Himavat, near the golden mountain of Meru. Rama, sitting under the shade of a well-known banian, had tied his matted locks together.

sa: एताश्चान्याश्च बहवो मातरो भतरर्षभ॥ कार्तिकेयानुयायिन्यो नानारूपा सहस्रशः।
en: These and many other mothers, O foremost of Bharata's race, numbering by thousands, of diverse forms, became the followers of Kartikeya.

sa: विप्रयातास्तु वो भिन्नान् पाण्डवाः कृतविप्रियाः॥ अनुसृत्य हनिष्यन्ति श्रेयानः समरे वधः।
en: If you fly away, in confusion, the sinful Pandavas will pursue you and kill you. If on the other hand we made a bold stand, it will do us good.

sa: तत उग्रं तपस्तप्त्वा वसिष्ठो धर्मवित्तमः। रक्षांस्युपावधीत् तस्य पन्थानं चाप्यविन्दत॥
en: Thereupon that foremost of righteous persons, viz, Vasishtha, practised very austere penances, and, causing those Rakshasas to be killed, ascertained the true course which Muchukunda was following.

sa: स गर्भ शिरसा देवो बहुवर्षाण्यधारयत्। पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे तु स गर्भः क्षुवतोऽपतत्॥
en: Therefore, he once conceived in his brain and held the foetus there for many long years. After a thousand years, the great god sneezed. In that act, the foetus dropped from his head.

sa: तत: पारिषदैश्चैव मातृभिश्च समन्वितः॥ ययौ दैत्यविनाशाय ह्लादयन् सुरपुङ्गवान्।
en: Accompanied by those companions and the mothers, he set out for the destruction of the demons, cheering up all the foremost of the celestials.

sa: परस्परं विलुम्पन्ति सारमेया यथामिषम्। अबलान् बलिनो मन्ति निर्मर्यादमवर्तत॥
en: All creatures began to rob, snatching meat from one another. The strong began to kill the weak. Nobody cared the least for his neighbour.

sa: ततो दैत्या विनिष्पेतुः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। प्रदीप्तात् पर्वतश्रेष्ठाद् विचित्राभरणस्रजः॥ तान् निजघ्नुरतिक्रम्य कुमारानुचरा मृघे। स चैव भगवान् क्रुद्धो दैत्येन्द्रस्य सुतं तदा॥
en: The Daityas then, by hundreds and thousands, came out of that burning mountain, all bedecked with beautiful ornaments and garlands. The followers of Kumara, overpowering them in battle, killed them all, the worshipful Skanda worked up with ire, killed the son of the Daitya chief (Vali) along with his younger brother as Indra has killed Vritra formerly.

sa: ऐश्वर्याणि च तत्रस्थो ददावीशः पृथक् पृथक्। ददौ नैर्ऋतमुख्येभ्यस्त्रैलोक्यं पावकात्मजः॥
en: The powerful son of Agni gave to each of those leading celestials various kinds of dominion and wealth and at last the sovereignty of the three worlds.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। पुरूरवस ऐलस्य संवादं मातरिश्वनः॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old story about the discourse between Pururavas the son of Aila and Matarishvan.

sa: तपश्चचार साऽत्युग्रं नियमैर्बहुभिर्वृता। भर्ता मे देवराजः स्यादिति निश्चित्य भामिनी॥
en: That beautiful damsel, observing various kinds of vows, practised the austerest of penances, moved by the desire of obtaining the Lord of the celestials for her husband.

sa: मा स्म ते ब्राह्मणं दृष्ट्वा धनस्थं प्रचलेन्मनः। अन्त्यायामप्यवस्थायां किमु स्फीतस्य भारत।॥
en: Your heart should not be agitated even when you are in great distress, upon seeing Brahmanas having wealth. I need not mention then of what you should do when you are well off.

sa: व्यश्वसूतरथं चक्रे सव्यसाची परन्तपः॥ मृदुपूर्वं ततश्चैनं पुनः पुनरताडयत्।
en: Immediately the great car-warrior Savyasachin deprived his antagonist of his horses, driver and car and without the least exertion struck him with three arrows.

sa: विभज्य दण्डः कर्तव्यो धर्मेण न यदृच्छया। दुष्टानां निग्रहो दण्डो हिरण्यं बाह्यतः क्रिया॥
en: Punishment should be meted out with discrimination, guided by righteousness and not by caprice. It is intended for checking the wicked. Fines and confiscation are intended for creating terror, and not for replenishing the king's treasury.

sa: द्रौणिस्तु समरे दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवस्य पराक्रमम्॥ रथेनातिपताकेन पाण्डवं प्रत्यवारयत्।
en: Beholding the prowess of Pandu's son in that battle, the son of Drona, on his car adorned with many banners, tried to check him.

sa: सोऽपि विंशत्यधिपतिर्वृत्तं जानपदे जने। ग्रामाणां शतपालाय सर्वमेव निवेदयेत्॥
en: The latter, again, should report the conduct of all the persons with in his province to the officer in charge of a hundred villages.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अयं गुणानां षट्त्रिंशत्पट्त्रिंशद्गुणसंयुतः। यान् गुणांस्तु गुणोपेतः कुर्वन् गुणमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: Bhishma said There are thirty-six virtues which a king should practise. There are another thirty-six related with these.. A virtuous person, by following these virtues, can certainly acquire great merit.

sa: कलावधर्मो भूयिष्ठं धर्मो भवति न क्वचित्। सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां स्वधर्माच्च्यवते मनः॥
en: During the age called Kali, unrighteousness assumes the full proportion and nothing of righteousness is seen. The hearts of men of all the orders, are disinclined to their respective duties.

sa: रक्षाभ्यधिकृता नाम तेभ्यो रक्षेदिमाः प्रजाः। विक्रयं क्रयमध्वानं भक्तं च सपरिच्छदम्॥
en: Looking after sales and the purchases, the state of the roads, the food and dress, and the stocks and profits, and the traders, the king should impose taxes on them.

sa: अशुभस्य यदा त्वधं द्वावंशावनुवर्तते। कृष्टपच्यैव पृथिवी भवत्यर्धफला तथा॥
en: A half of unrighteousness follows the observance of the great science by half. The Earth yields crops by half and that even by tillage.

sa: इत्येव चिन्तयामास महर्षिरसितस्तदा॥ स्नात्वा समुद्रे विधिवच्छुचिर्जप्यं जजाप सः।
en: Thus thought the great Rishi Asita. Duly performing his ablutions there and purifying himself thereby, he then began to silently recite the sacred mantras.

sa: न च वश्यो भवेदस्य नृपो यश्चातिवीर्यवान्। हीनश्च बलवीर्याभ्यां कर्षयंस्तत्परो वसेत्॥
en: A king should not for ever live under a more powerful king. Though weak, he should try to assail the stronger and resolved upon this continue to rule his own.

sa: कलत्रमादितः कृत्वा सर्वं वो विनशेदिति। अपि चेत् पुत्रदारार्थमर्थसंचय इष्यते॥
en: On the other hand, they will even kill all your relatives with your very wives. Forsooth, you wish wealth for the sake of your children and wives.

sa: नानाशस्त्रौघबहुलां शस्त्रावृष्टिं समुद्यताम्। व्यधमत् समरे राजा महाभ्राणीव मारुतः॥
en: Like the wind scattering masses of clouds, the king of the Madras, in that battle, dispersed the shower of arrows and various other weapons.

sa: यो नोपकर्तुं शक्नोति नोपकर्तुं महीपतिः। न शक्यरूपश्चोद्धर्तुमुपेक्ष्यस्तादृशो भवेत्॥
en: A king should not deal with a person who can neither benefit nor injure him, or with one who cannot save himself from distress,

sa: आत्मा जेयः सदा राज्ञा ततो जेयाश्च शत्रवः। अजितात्मा नरपतिविजयेत कथं रिपून्॥
en: The king should first conquer himself and then try to subdue his enemies. He can a king who has not been able to conquer his own self be able to conquer his enemies?

sa: एतयोपमया वीर संनमेत बलीयसे। इन्द्राय स प्रणमते नमते यो बलीयसे॥
en: Guided by these examples, O hero, men should bend before those that are powerful. The man who bends his head to a powerful person really bends his head to Indra.

sa: तत्रैकबाणनिहतानपश्याम महागजान्। पतितान् पात्यमानांश्च निर्भिन्नान् सव्यसाचिना॥
en: Each killed with a single arrows, we saw those huge elephants fallen or falling down, wounded by Savyasachin.

sa: भीष्म उवाच राष्ट्रस्यैतत् कृत्यतमं राज्ञ एवाभिषेचनम्। अनिन्द्रमबलं राष्ट्रं दस्यवोऽभिभवन्त्युत॥
en: The (election and) coronation of a king is the first duty of kingdom. A kingdom in which anarchy reigns becomes weak and is soon attacked by robbers.

sa: तानापतत एवाशु पञ्चानां वै भुजच्युतान्। वारयामास समरे शस्त्रसङ्घः स मद्रराट्॥
en: The king of the Madras, however speedily counteracted in that battle all those weapons, shot off the arms of those five warriors at him, as these proceeded towards his car.

sa: एष द्वादशवार्षिक्यामनावृष्ट्यां द्विजर्षभान्॥ सारस्वतो महाभागे वेदानध्यापयिष्यति।
en: During a drought extending over iwelve years, this Sarasvat, will teach the Vedas to many best of Brahmanas.

sa: मधुदोहं दुहेद् राष्ट्र भ्रमरा इव पादपम्। वत्सापेक्षी दुहेच्चैव स्तनांश्च न विकुट्टयेत्॥
en: A king should milk his kingdom like a bee collecting honey from plants. He should act like the cow-herd who takes milk from her without boring her udders and without starving the calf.

sa: आच्छादयसि प्रावारान नासि पिशितौदनम्। आजानेया वहन्त्यश्वाः केनासि हरिणः कृशः॥
en: You are clad in the best robes. You take the richest food. Horses of the best species bear you. Why then have you become pale and emaciated?

sa: जगाम त्रिदिवं राजन् संत्यज्येह कलेवरम्। सुभूः सा ह्यथ कल्याणी पुण्डीरीकनिभेक्षणा॥
en: Meanwhile, that faultless and amiable and fair-browed maider, having eyes like lotus petals, continued to prectise severe and very rigid penances. She adored the Pitris and the gods with fasts.

sa: मोक्तुकामां तु तां दृष्ट्वा शरीरं नारदोऽब्रवीत्॥ असंस्कृतायाः कन्यायाः कुतो लोकास्तवानघे।
en: Seeing her about to relinquish her body, Narada said to her,"O sinless one, you cannot attain any blissful region since you have not cleansed yourself by the rite of marriage.

sa: न चास्था ने न चाकाले करांस्तेभ्यो निपातयेत्। आनुपूर्वेण सान्त्वेन यथाकालं यथाविधि॥
en: The king should never impose taxes in a bad form and on persons who cannot pay them. He should impose them gradually and with mildness, in proper time and according to due forms.

sa: ते पृष्टा यदुसिंहेन कुरुक्षेत्रफलं विभो। समाचख्युर्महात्मानस्तस्मै सर्वं यथातथम्॥
en: Asked by that Yadu's chief about the results of the battle at Kurukshetra, those great ones told him everything as it had taken place.

sa: अत्रैव ब्राह्मणी सिद्धा कौमारब्रह्मचारिणी। योगयुक्ता दिवं याता तप:सिद्धा तपस्विनी॥
en: Here leading from youth the vow of Brahmacharya, a Brahmani inaiden, was crowned with ascetic success. Ultimately possessed of Yoga powers that ascetic lady went to heaven.

sa: कृतपापस्त्वसौ राजा य एतान् न नियच्छति। तथा कृतस्य धर्मस्र चतुर्भागमुपारनुते॥
en: The king who fails to restrain himself commits a sin. He is visited by a fourth part of their sins as he does acquire a fourth part of their merits.

sa: ब्रह्मलोकपरा भूत्वा प्रार्थयन्तो जयं युधि॥ सुयुद्धेन पराक्रान्ता नराः स्वर्गमभीप्स्वः।
en: Desirous of going to the regions of Brahman and longing for victory by fair fight, the warriors displayed their prowess worked up with the hope of heaven.

sa: शयानं धार्तराष्ट्रं तु सलिले स्तम्भिते तदा॥ पाण्डवाः सह कृष्णेन वाग्भिरुयाभिरादयन्।
en: While resting at the bottom of the lake after solidifying its waters, Duryodhana approached by the Pandavas with Krishna and cut to the quick by their cruel words. are was

sa: ततोऽपरो महाराज प्रज्वलन्निव तेजसा॥ शरीरानिःसृतस्तस्य प्रह्लादस्य महात्मनः।
en: Upon the disappearance of Righteousness, a third highly effulgent form, O monarch, issued out of the body of the great Prahlada.

sa: त्वं हि सत्यव्रता देवी लोकस्य परमेश्वरी। कश्चासौ ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठस्तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: You are ever devoted to truth, O goddess, and you are the foremost of deities. Who is that foremost of Brahmanas? I wish to know the truth!

sa: तदनीकमभिप्रेक्ष्य ततस्ते पाण्डुनन्दनाः॥ प्रययुः सिंहनादेन दुर्योधनपुरोगमान्।
en: Beholding the Kauravas the sons of Pandu, sending up leonine shouts, rushed against those Warriors led by Duryodhana.

sa: तस्य वृत्तिं प्रवक्ष्यामि यच्च तस्योपजीवनम्॥ अवश्यं भरणीयो हि वर्णानां शूद्र उच्यते।
en: I shall now describe the profession, he should pursue and the means by which he may earn his subsistence. It is said that the Shudras should be maintained by the three other castes.

sa: हत्वेमं पापकर्माणं गदया रणमूर्धनि। अद्यास्य शतधा देहं भिनद्मि गदयाऽनया॥ नायं प्रवेष्टा नगरं पुनर्वारणसाह्वयम्।
en: Killing this sinful person with my mace on the field of battle, I shall to-day, with this very mace of mine, break his body into a hundred pieces! He shall not have again to enter the city of Hastinapur!

sa: असम्भवे श्रियो राजन् हीनस्य सचिवादिभिः। दैवे प्रतिनिविष्टे च किं श्रेयो मन्यते भवान्॥
en: When it is impossible for you to recover your prosperity and when you are without ministers and counsellors, such a course is open to you. Do you expect to reap any benefit by depending upon destiny?

sa: ततः स्वरथमारोप्य मद्राणामृषभं रणे॥ अपोवाह कृपः शल्यं तूर्णमायोधनादथ।
en: Then the powerful Kripa, taking up Shalya, that king of the Madras, on his own car, quickly took him away from the battle field.

sa: ब्राह्मणस्य तु यो धर्मस्तं ते वक्ष्यामि केवलम्॥ दममेव महाराज धर्मबाहुः पुरातनम्। स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव तत्र कर्म समाप्यते॥
en: I shall now describe the duties which the Brahmanas should exclusively follow. Selfcontrol, o king, has been declared to be the first duty of Brahmanas. Study of the Vedas, and patient practice of austerities, (are also their other duties). By practising these two, all their acts are done.

sa: शुश्रुवे दिक्षु सर्वासु तयोः पुरुषसिंहयोः। गदानिपातसंहादो वज्रयोरिव नि:स्वनः॥
en: The sound caused by the strokes of the maces of those two best of men was heard on all sides like peals of thunder.

sa: महत्त्वात् तस्य दण्डस्य नीतिर्विस्पश्लक्षणा। नयचारश्च विपुलो येन सर्वमिदं ततम्॥
en: For the might of his sceptre, the practice of morality and just conduct became so visible on Earth. It is therefore that the Earth abounded with virtues.

sa: बृहन्ति कुञ्जरास्तत्र हया द्वेषन्ति चासकृत्। शस्त्राणि चाप्यदीप्यन्त पाण्डवानां जयैषिणाम्॥
en: The elephants present there grunted aloud and the horses neighed repeatedly. The weapons of the Pandavas, who were eager for victory, shone resplendent with their own luster.

sa: शुभं हि कर्म राजेन्द्र शुभत्वायोपकल्पते। तुल्यस्यैकस्य यस्यायं लोको वचसि तिष्ठते॥
en: Good acts, O king, lead to good. It is therefore that a great many obey his command, through he belongs to the same world and is possessed of similar limbs.

sa: गदया मद्रराजस्य सव्यदक्षिणमाहतः। भीमसेनो महाबाहुन् चचालाचलो तथा॥
en: Struck by the king of the Madras on both his left and right, the mighty-armed Bhimasena stood firın like a mountain.

sa: तौ गदाभिहतैर्गात्रैः क्षणेन रुधिरोक्षितौ। प्रेक्षणीयतरावास्तां पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ॥
en: On being struck with each other's mace, they soon became bathed in blood and looked more beautiful like two blossoming Kinshukas.

sa: आशां महत्तरां मन्ये पर्वतादपि सदुमात्। आकाशादपि वा राजनप्रमेयैव वा पुनः॥
en: I think that hope is bigger than a mountain with all its trees. Or, perhaps, it is bigger than the sky itself. Or, perhaps, O king, it is really immeasurable.

sa: मण्डलानि विचित्राणि चरतोपभीमयोः। गदासम्पातजास्तत्र प्रजजुः पावकार्चिषः॥
en: While the king and Bhima moved about in beautiful circles, their maces clashed, which created sparks of fire.

sa: मे आत्मनाश्म इत्येव श्रुतिरेषा परा नृषु। उत्पन्नौ बन्दिनौ चास्य तत्पूर्वी सूतमागधौ॥
en: This great declaration of Shrutis is known among men that Prithu is the eighth from Vishnu, A little before two persons named Suta and Magadha were born. They became his bards and panegyrists.

sa: तथा मद्राधिरपस्यापि गदावेगं महात्मनः। सोढुमुत्सहते नान्यो योधो युधि वृकोदरात्॥
en: Similarly except Bhima there is no other warriors that can venture to stand the force of the mace of the illustrious king of the Madras in battle.

sa: स तस्य बाणैर्बहुभिः समभ्यस्तो वनेचरः। प्रक्रीडन्निव राजेन्द्र पुनरभ्येति चान्तिकम्॥
en: Pierced with many arrows by the king, that wild animal, O monarch, as if in sport, again and again lessened the distance between itself and the pursuer.

sa: तं दीप्तमिव कालाग्निं पाशहस्तमिवान्तकम्। सशृङ्गमिव कैलासं सवज्रमिव वासवम्॥ सशूलमिव हर्यक्षं वने मत्तमिव द्विपम्। जवेनाभ्यपतद् भीम: प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम्॥
en: Bhima, however, armed with his mighty mace, rushed impetuously towards Shalya who shone like the blazing Yuga fire or the Destroyer armed with the noose or the Kailasa mountain with his summit or Vasava with this thunder or Mahadeva with his thunder or Mahadeva with his trident or an infuriate elephant in the forest.

sa: तस्य भीमो रणे क्रुद्धः संदश्य दशनच्छदम्। विनाशायाभिसंधाय गजामादाय वीर्यवान्॥
en: Then biting his lips and beside himself with range, the valiant Bhima took up his mace in that battle and aimed it at Shalya for killing him.

sa: शल्योऽपि राजन् संक्रुद्धो निघ्नन् सोमकपाण्डवान्। पुनरेव शितैर्बाणैयुधिष्ठिरमपीडयत्॥
en: Shalya also excited with anger, O king, killed many Somakas and Pandavas and once more assailed Yudhishthira with many sharp arrows.

sa: अहो धिग् यदधो नाभेः प्रहृतं धर्मविग्रहे। नैतद् दृष्टं गदायुद्धे कृतवान् यद् वृकोदरः॥
en: Oh, fie, that in such a fair fight a blow has been inflicted below the navel! Never before has such an act, as has been done by Vrikodara, been seen in an encounter with the mace!

sa: पाल्यमानास्तथान्योन्यं नरा धर्मेण भारत। खेदं परमुपाजग्मुस्ततस्तान् मोह आविशत्॥
en: As they thus lived, O Bharata, righteously protecting one another, they found the task (in time), to be painful. Error then possessed their hearts.

sa: अद्यः वः सरथान् साश्वानशस्त्रो विरथोऽपि सन्। नक्षत्राणीव सर्वाणि सविता रात्रिसंक्षये॥
en: Rising I shall fight all of you in battle Like the year that one by one meets with all the seasons, I shall meet with all of you in fight.

sa: सेयं रत्नसमाकीर्णा मही सवनपर्वता। उपावृत्ता महाराज त्वामद्य निहतद्विषम्॥
en: Filled with all sorts of gems, the Earth, with her forests and mountains, O king, once more approaches you who have no foes alive.'

sa: यः सत्करोति ज्ञानानि ज्ञेये परहिते रतः। सतां वानुगस्त्यागी स राजा राज्यमर्हति॥
en: That king truly deserves to govern who honours knowledge, who is devoted to the no scriptures and the good of his people, who wends the path of the righteous, and who is liberal.

sa: तस्य शल्यः शरं घोरं मुमोचासीविषोपमम्॥ स निर्भिद्य महात्मानं वेगेनाभ्यपतच गाम्।
en: Then Shalya shot a dreadful arrow at Yudhishthira that resembled a a snake of dreadful venom. Piercing through the highsouled son of Kunti, that arrow quickly dropped down the Earth.

sa: शिबिरं समनुप्राप्य कुरुराजस्य पाण्डवाः। अवरुर्महाराज रथेभ्यो रथसत्तमाः॥
en: Arriving at the pavilion of the Kuru king, the Pandavas, those foremost of car-warriors, O king, got down from their cars.

sa: द्विरदास्तुरगाश्चार्ताः पत्तयो रथिनस्तथा। शल्यस्य बाणैरपतन् बभ्रमुळनदंस्तथा॥
en: Elephants and horses and foot-soldiers and car-warriors, assailed with Shalya's arrows, fell down or strayed away bewailing loudly.

sa: अभ्यवर्षत धर्मात्मा कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। भीमसेनं शरैश्चापि रुक्मपुत्रैः शिलाशितैः॥
en: Shalya, who never knew depression, then poured showers of arrows on Yudhishthira the son of Kunti, like the thousand-eyed Indra pouring rain in torrents.

sa: एवमेव यदा विद्वान् मन्यतेऽतिबलं रिपुम्। संश्रयेद् वैतसी वृत्तिमेतत् प्रज्ञानलक्षणम्॥
en: An intelligent man, therefore, when he sees liis enemy to be more powerful than himself imitate the conduct of the cane. That is a sign of wisdom.

sa: पाण्डवा अपि भूपाल समरे जितकाशिनः। मद्रराजं समासाद्य बिभिदुर्निशितैः शरैः॥
en: The Pandavas also, O king, in that battle, filled with the desire of victory, proceeded against the king of the Madras and struck him with keen arrows.

sa: वर्तितव्यं कुरुश्रेष्ठ सदा धर्मानुवर्तिना। स्वं प्रियं तु परित्यज्य यद् यल्लोकहितं भवेत्॥
en: A righteous king, O foremost one of Kuru's race, should always act in such a manner, as to sacrifice what he loves most for the sake of securing the well-being of his people.

sa: भ्रातृभिः समयं कृत्वा क्षान्तवान् धर्मवत्सलः। द्यूतच्छलजितैः शुद्धर्वनवासो ह्युपागतः॥
en: Having made a compact with his brothers, the virtuous Yudhishthira had lived peacefully. He even went to exile after the unfair defeat at dice.

sa: एतत्सर्वमनुध्याय आत्मनश्च व्यतिक्रमम्॥ शिवेन पाण्डवान् पाहि नमस्ते भरतर्षभ।
en: Thinking of all this, and thinking also of your own sins, cherish good feelings towards the Pandavas. I bow to you, O Bharata chief.

sa: आगमश्च परस्त्वत्तः परंतप। भवन्तं हि परं बुद्धौ वासुदेवोऽभिमन्यते॥
en: O destroyer of foes, Vasudeva considers you as the foremost of all intelligent persons. Therefore, all of us expect the best knowledge from you.'

sa: वेदोक्ताश्चैव ये धर्मा वेदान्ताधिगताच ये। तान् सर्वान् सम्प्रपश्यामि वरदानात् तवाच्युत॥
en: I behold clearly, O you of unfading glory, by virtue of the boon granted by you to me, all the duties laid down in the Vedas, and in the Vedantas.

sa: तेऽभिगम्य महात्मानो भरतानां पितामहम्। अन्वशोचन्त गाङ्गेयमादित्यं पतितं यथा॥
en: Approaching the grandfather of the Bharatas who shone like the Sun himself dropped from the sky, those great persons began to bewail for him.

sa: शरतल्पे शयानं तमादित्यं पतितं यथा। स ददर्श महाबाहुं भयाच्चागतसाध्वसः।२८॥
en: Possessed by fear, the king timidly cast his eyes on the mighty-armed hero lying on his bed of arrows like the Sun himself dropped from the sky.

sa: कृतघ्नेषु च या सक्ता नृशंसेष्वलसेषु च। अपकारिषु चासत्ता साऽऽशा कृशतरीमया॥
en: The hope in an ungrateful man, or in one who is cruel, or in one who is idle, or in one who injures others, is slenderer than even my body.

sa: वीणापणववेणूनां स्वनश्चातिमनोरमः। सहास इव विस्तीर्णः शुश्रुवे तस्य वेश्मनः॥
en: The charming sound also of Vinas; Panavas, and bamboo flutes, was heard. The spacious edifice of Krishna, seemed, as if to laugh with music.

sa: रक्षाधिकरणं युद्धं तथा धर्मानुशासनम्। मन्त्रचिन्ता सुखं काले पञ्चभिर्वर्धते मही॥
en: The defence of forts, battle, administration of justice, consultations on questions of policy, and keeping the subjects of happiness, these five increase the dominions of a king.

sa: ताते मुहूर्ताद् भगवान् सहस्रांशुर्दिवाकरः। दहन वैनमिवैकान्ते प्रतीच्या प्रत्यदृश्यत॥
en: Soon after, like a fire at the outskirt of a great forest, the divine Sun of a thousand rays was seen to descend westwards.

sa: नैतान्येकेन शक्यानि सातत्येनानुवीक्षितुम्। तेषु सर्वं प्रतिष्ठाप्य राजा भुक्के चिरं महीम्॥
en: It is impossible, however, for one man to look after all these matters at all times. Transferring such supervision to his ministers, a king may govern the Earth for ever,

sa: ततो गृहीत्वा तीक्ष्णाग्रमर्धचन्द्रं सुतेजनम्। सुवेगवन्तं चिक्षेप कर्णपुत्राय संयुगे॥
en: Then taking up a sharp and powerful arrow having a semi-circular head, Nakula shot it with great force at Karna's son in that battle.

sa: पूर्वमप्यतिदुःशीलो न धैर्यं कर्तुमर्हति॥ तपत्यर्थे विपन्ने हि मित्राणां न कृतं वचः।
en: He had, from the very commencement been very wicked. He could not check himself. He did not satisfy the wishes of friends. For all that, he is now sunk in grief and calamity.

sa: गौतम उवाच मातापितृभ्यामानृण्यं किं कृत्वा समवाप्नुयात्। कथं च लोकानाप्नोति पुरुषो दुर्लभाशुचीन्॥
en: Gotama said How does a man liberate his self from the debt he owes to his parents? How, also, does he succeed in acquiring blissful regions which it is so difficult to acquire.

sa: अश्वमेधैश्च यष्टव्यं बहुभिः स्वाप्तदक्षिणैः। तेन लोकानवाप्नोति पुरुषोऽद्भुतदर्शनान्॥
en: One should, also, celebrate Horse-sacrifices with profuse presents to the Brahmanas. By such acts one acquires many happy and wonderful regions.'

sa: अपि सर्वगुणैर्युक्तं भर्तारं प्रियवादिनम्। अभिद्रुह्यति पापात्मा न तस्माद् विश्वसेज्जनात्॥
en: A sinful man seeks to injure his master even if the latter be sweet-speeched and endued with every accomplishment. Do not, therefore, repose confidence in such men.

sa: तावेन प्रत्यविध्येतां पृथक् पृथगजिह्मगैः॥ सारथिं चास्य राजेन्द्र शितैर्विव्यधतुः शरैः।
en: Each of the latter separately struck the son of Pandu in return with ma..y straight coursing arrows. Afterwards they struck Nakula's driver also with many keen arrows.

sa: न चाप्यलब्धं लिप्सेत मूले नातिदृढे सति। न हि दुर्बलमूलस्य राज्ञो लाभो विधीयते॥
en: When the sovereign's own power has not been consolidated, he should not try to make new acquisitions. It is not proper that a king whose power has not been confirmed should try to make such acquisitions.

sa: कर्मणा बुद्धिपूर्वेण भवत्याढ्यो न वा पुनः। तादृशोऽयमनुप्रश्नः संव्यवस्यः स्वया धिया॥
en: By acting intelligently the king may or may not acquire wealth. Guided by your own intelligence do you think what reply should be given to your query on this subject.

sa: पञ्चालेषु भविष्यामि सूदयन्नद्य संयुगे। पिनाकपाणिः संक्रुद्धः स्वयं रुद्रः पशुष्विव॥
en: While engaged in the act of destruction I shall move about in their midst like the holder of Pinaka, viz., the angry Rudra himself, among living creatures!

sa: स तेनाकुण्ठधारेण ज्वलितानलवर्चसा। कुठारेणाप्रमेयेण लोकेष्वप्रतिमोऽभवत्॥
en: For that peerless axe of fiery splendour and irresistible sharpness, he became unequalled on Earth.

sa: अद्यापि त्वहमाशंसे त्वां विजेतुं युधिष्ठिर। भक्त्वा पाञ्चालपाण्डूनामुत्साहं भरतर्षभ॥
en: I, however, still hope to defeat you, O Yudhishthira, after checking the pride, O foremost of Bharata's race, of the Panchalas and the Pandus.

sa: विश्वामित्रं च दायादं गाधिः कुशिकनन्दनः। यः प्राप ब्रह्मसमितं विश्वैर्ब्रह्मगुणैर्युतम्॥
en: Kaushika's son Gadhi begot a son named Vishvamitra. Possessed of every attribute of a Brahmana, that son though a Kshatriya by birth was equal to a Brahmana.

sa: क्षीणरत्नां च पृथिवी हतक्षत्रियपुङ्गवाम्। न ह्युत्सहाम्यहं भोक्तुं विधवामिव योषितम्॥
en: I do not like to enjoy and longer the Earth that does not contain wealth and best of Kshatriyas and that has accordingly become like a widow.

sa: अथान्यं रथमास्थाय धनुरादाय चापरम्॥ सत्यसेनः सुषेणश्च पाण्डवं पर्यधावताम्।
en: At this the latter, mounting on another car and taking up another bow, as also his brother Sushena, rushed against the son of Pandu.

sa: अविज्ञानादयोगो हि पुरुषस्योपजायते। विज्ञानादपि योगश्च योगो भूतिकरः परः॥ अशङ्कमानो वचनमनसूयुरिदं शृणु।
en: Ignorance yields barrenness of invention about means. Finding out of expedicnts, again, through the help of knowledge, becomes the source of great happiness. Without cherishing any misgivings and any malice, here these instructions.

sa: किं नाम दुःखं लोकेऽस्मिन् पितुर्वधमनुस्मरन्॥ हृदयं निर्दहन्मेऽद्य रात्र्यहानि न शाम्यति।
en: How great is the sorrow of that person who is always thinking of the death of his father. My heart is now burning day and night! I cannot enjoy peace.

sa: पौरजानपदा यस्य भूतेषु च दयालवः। सधना धान्यवन्तश्च दृढमूलः स पार्थिवः॥
en: The power of that king, whose subjects whether living in the cities or the provinces, have mercy for all creatures, and posses wealth and gain, is said to be confirmed.

sa: शुश्रूषुस्त्वेव मेधावी पुरुषो नियतेन्द्रियः। जानीयादागमान् सर्वान् ग्राह्यं च न विरोधयेत्॥
en: An intelligent person who waits upon his superiors and who has controlled his passions succeeds in understanding all the rules of morality and never disputes what is accepted by all.

sa: चित्रसेनरथं प्राप्य चित्रयोधी जितश्रमः॥ आरुरोह महाबाहुः सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः।
en: Getting at the car of Chitrasena, the mightyarmed hero, the untiring son of Pandu, conversant with all modes of warfare, appeared before the troops.

sa: हयांश्चास्य शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः प्रेषयामास मृत्यवे॥ तथा ध्वजं सारथिं च त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरपातयत्।
en: With a few more sharp arrows he killed Nakula's horses, Next he struck down both the standard and the driver of his antagonist, each with three arrows.

sa: अलाभे सति वा लाभे समदर्शी महातपाः। न जिजीविषुवत् किंचिन्न मुमूर्षुवदाचरन्।॥
en: Unmoved in success and failure, I shall earn great ascetic merit, I shall behave neither like one who is fond of life nor like one who is about to die.

sa: एकसार्थप्रयातौ स्वस्त्वया सह नरर्षभ। समदुःखसुखौ चापि नावां शङ्कितुमर्हसि॥
en: We are determined to accompany you tomorrow, O foremost of men! We sympathies with you in weal and woe. You should not mistrust us.'

sa: अश्वत्थामा तु संक्रुद्धः पितर्वधमनुस्मरन्। ताभ्यां तथ्यंऽऽचख्यौ यदस्यात्मचिकीर्षितम्॥
en: Remembering the slaughter of his father, Ashvatthaman in anger told them truly about the work that he had resolved to accomplish.

sa: अन्यत्र राजन् हिंसाया वृत्तिर्नेहास्ति कस्यचित्। अप्यरण्यसमुत्थस्य एकस्य चरतो मुनेः॥
en: No person in this world, O king, can maintain himself without injuring other creatures. The very ascetic leading a solitary life in the forest is no exception.

sa: नान्यानपीडयित्वेह कोशः शक्यः कुतो बलम्। तदर्थं पीडयित्वा च दोषं प्राप्तुं न सोऽर्हति॥
en: The treasury can never be replenished without oppressing others. How then can the army be maintained without oppression? The king, therefore, in times of difficulty, commits no sin by oppressing his subjects for filling the treasury.

sa: अकार्यमपि यज्ञार्थं क्रियते यज्ञकर्मसु। एतस्मात् कारणाद् राजा न दोषं प्राप्तुमर्हति॥
en: For celebrating sacrifices many improper deeds are done. Therefore a king commits no sin by doing improper acts (when he seeks to fill his treasury in a time of distress).

sa: धनेन जयते लोकावुभौ परमिमं तथा। सत्यं च धर्मवचनं यथा नास्त्यधनस्तथा॥
en: By wealth, both the worlds, viz., this and the other, can be acquired, as also Truth and religious merit. A person who has no wealth is more dead than alive.

sa: अश्वत्थामा पृष्ठतोऽभूत् काम्बोजैः परिवारितः॥ दुर्योधनोऽभवन्मध्ये रक्षितः कुरुपुङ्गवैः।
en: In the rear was Ashvathaman surrounded by the Kambojas. In the centre was Duryodhana, protected by the best of Kuru warriors.

sa: स चेत् सन्नद्ध आगच्छेत् सन्नद्धव्यं ततो भवेत्। स चेत् ससैन्य आगच्छेत् ससैन्यस्तमथाह्वयेत्॥
en: If the enemy comes clad in mail, his opponent also should put on armour. If the enemy advances with an army at his back, one should, calling into requisition, his own strength, give him the battle.

sa: महाजगरवक्त्राश्च हंसवक्त्राः सितप्रभाः। दार्वाघाटमुखाश्चापि चाषवत्राश्च भारत॥ कूर्मनक्रमुखाश्चैव शिशुमारमुखास्तथा। महामकरवक्त्राश्च तिमिवक्त्रास्तथैव च॥ हरिवक्त्रा: क्रौञ्चमुखाः कपोतेमुखास्तथा। पारावतमुखाश्चैव मद्गुवक्त्रास्तथैव च।॥
en: And the faces of some were like those of snakes, and others had faces like those ducks. And all of them were highly effulgent. And the faces of some were like those of wood-packers, and joys; of tortoises, alligators, porpoises, huge sharks, and whales; of lions, cranes, pigeons, elephants, and shags,.

sa: जलाशयं प्रविष्टोऽद्य वाञ्छञ्जीवितमात्मनः। उत्तिष्ठ राजन् युध्यस्व सहास्माभिः सुयोधन॥
en: Why have you entered into this lake today, with a view to save your own life? Arise, O king and fight us, O Suyodhana.

sa: अपचिक्रमिषुः क्षिप्रं साम्ना वा परिसान्त्वयन्। विलवयित्वा मन्त्रेण ततः स्वयमुपक्रमेत्॥
en: Or by the sweetest words he should please them by means of conciliation and again by the consultation with wise men he should act to regain it.

sa: प्रासानां पततां राजन् रूपमासीत् समन्ततः। शलभानामिवाकाशे तदा भरतसत्तम॥
en: The view presented, O best of the Bharatas, by the lances hurled all around, was like that of swarms of locusts in the sky.

sa: आर्षमप्यत्र पश्यन्ति विकर्मस्थस्य पातनम्। न तादृक्सदृशं किञ्चित् प्रमाणं दृश्यते क्वचित्॥
en: There are even great Rishis who have laid down that even preceptors, if addicted to evil practices, should be punished. But there is no recognised authority for such a holding.

sa: देवताश्च विकर्मस्थं पातयन्ति नराधमम्। व्याजेन विन्दन् वित्तं हि धर्मात् स परिहीयते॥
en: The gods will punish such men when they happen to be vile and guilty of wicked practices. The king, who replenishes his treasury by fraudulent means, certainly deviates from the path of righteousness.

sa: अन्योयं परिपिष्टाश्च समासाद्य परस्परम्। आविक्षताः स्म दृश्यन्ते वमन्तो रुधिरं मुखैः॥
en: They all remained huddled together. many of them were wounded and many vomited blood. A thick darkness set in there when the troops were covered with a cloud of dust.

sa: पश्येमा धार्तराष्ट्रेण मायामप्सु प्रयोजिताम्॥ विष्टभ्य सलिलं शेते नास्य मानुषतो भयम्।
en: "Behold, the son of Dhritarashtra has enchanted these waters by his power of illusion. Having enchanted the waters, he lives within them. He entertains no fear of injury from man.

sa: स हत्वा भक्षयित्वा च तमुष्ट्र जम्बुकस्तदा। विगते वातवर्षे निश्चक्राम गुहामुखात्॥
en: Within a short time the camel was dead. Having thus killed and eaten the camel, the jackal then came out of the cave after the storm and shower had ceased.

sa: प्राणानुपासृजद् वीरः सुहृदां दुःखमुत्सृजन्। अपाक्रामद् दिवं पुण्यां शरीरं क्षितिमाविशत्॥
en: Casting off his sorrow for all his killed kinsmen, he then breathed his last. His soul went to holy heaven, while his body only remained on Earth.

sa: यथासुखं यथाजोषं जयोऽयमनुभूयताम्। विश्रान्ताल्लंब्यविज्ञानाश्वः समेतास्मि वः पुनः॥
en: With great joy and ease enjoy this victory. After taking rest and refreshing your faculties, meet me again in the morning.

sa: अरण्ये दुःखवसतीमत्कृते भरतर्षभाः। भवद्भिरनुभूता हि यथा कुपुरुषैस्तथा॥
en: Through my fault, O foremost of Bharata's race, you have suffered the miseries of banishment in the forests like ordinary men.

sa: दीनान्धकृपणानां च गृहाच्छादनभोजनैः॥ आनृशंस्यपरो राजा चकारानुग्रहं प्रभुः।
en: The powerful king showed kindness towards the destitute and the blind and the helpless by giving them food, clothes and protection.

sa: अतसीपुष्पसंकाशं पीतवाससमच्युतम्। ये नमस्यन्ति गोविन्दं न तेषां विद्यते भयम्॥
en: Those who worship you, are freed from all fears, O Govinda of undecaying prowess, you are clad in yellow robes of the colour of the Atasi flower.

sa: एतैर्नरगजाश्वानां प्रासशक्तिपरश्वधैः। सहस्राणि निकृन्तद्भिनि:शेषं ते बलं कृतम्॥
en: Killing thousands of men and elephants and horses with lances and darts and battle-axes, those men have rotted out your army.

sa: लब्धचेतास्तु कौन्तेयः शोकविह्वलया गिरा। जित्वा शत्रूञ्जितः पश्चात् पर्यदेवयदार्तवत्॥
en: Having regained his senses, the son of Kunti bewailed in grief. Alas, having defeated the enemy, we have ourselves been defeated in the end.

sa: कायव्यः कर्मणा तेन महतीं सिद्धिमाप्तवान्। साधूनामाचरन् क्षेमं दस्यून् पापान्निवर्तयन्॥
en: By behaving thus, by thus doing good to the honest and by thus restraining the robbers from bad practices, Kayavya acquired great success (in the next world).

sa: दाशार्हेणाभ्यनुज्ञातस्तत्र धौम्यः पुरोहितः। प्रागुदवप्रवणां वेदी लक्षणेनोपलिख्य च॥
en: Then requested by Krishna, the priest Dhaumya, constructed according to rule, an alter gradually inclining towards the east and the north.

sa: असाधुभ्योऽर्थमादाय साधुभ्यो यः प्रयच्छति। आत्मानं संक्रमं कृत्वा कृत्स्नधर्मविदेव सः॥
en: He, who is the instrument of acquisition and, taking away wealth from the wicked, gives them to those that are good, knows well the science of virtue.

sa: ततः प्रकृतयः सर्वाः पुरस्कृत्य पुरोहितम्। ददृशुर्धर्मराजानमादाय बहुमङ्गलम्॥
en: Then headed by the priest all the subjects came to see king Yudhishthira, bringing with them various kinds of sacred articles,

sa: मध्ये कृत्वा तु राजानं भीमसेनार्जुनावुभौ। निषीदतुर्महात्मानौ श्लक्ष्णयोर्मणिपीठयोः॥
en: Placing the king in their midst, on his two sides sat Bhima and Arjuna upon two beautiful seats set with gerns.
